name: branch-do-file-missing-exception
description: branch's matching case names a do file that does not exist, reporting the read failure as an "Exception: " detail rather than a caller-crafted "not found" message, since the do-block resolution has no try/catch of its own on either side
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch missing do file
proxy: optional
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: loginRsp"
- branch:
    from: loginRsp
    on:
      - match:
          status: 200
        do: "{{DIR}}/missing-branch-do.yml"
